test_title: PYST 34: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 12 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the word-pair that best represents a similar relationship to the one expressed in the pair of words given below. (The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must not be related to each other based on the number of letters/number of consonants/vowels in the word.)

Lion : Roar
solution:
The logic followed here is : **Animal : Sound**

 
• Sound of **lion** is called **roar**.

So,

 
• Option - (1) : Hen : Crow

⇒ Sound of hen is called clucking and sound of crow is called caw.

 
• Option - (2) : Owl : Bleat

⇒ Sound of owl is called hoot and sound of sheep or goat is called bleat.

 
• Option - (3) : Horse : Neigh

**⇒ Sound of horse is called neigh.**

 
• Option - (4) : Goat : Hoot

⇒ Sound of goat is called bleat and sound of owl is called hoot.

Thus, out of all options **only option - (3) follows the same logic as given**.

Hence, **"Option - (3)"** is the correct answer.
